MAHALAGANG ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA🚦

Asahan ang posibleng pagbagal ng daloy ng trapiko sa paligid ng Sto. Niño Parochial School at Sto. Niño Church sa January 17, 2026 (Sabado) bunsod ng isasagawang Sto. Niño Parochial School Parade 2026 at Sto. Niño Grand Procession 2026.  

Magpapatupad ng partial road closure sa harap ng Sto. Niño Parochial School mula Bukidnon Street hanggang Ilocos Norte Street.

Magtutulungan at nakaantabay ang mga tauhan ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD), Department of Public Order and Safety (DPOS), Task Force Disiplina, at Quezon City Police District (QCPD) para maisaayos ang inaasahang pagbigat ng daloy ng trapiko sa nasabing lugar.

Pinapayuhan ang mga motorista na dumaan sa mga alternatibong ruta.

Maraming salamat po sa inyong pang-unawa.

data.text:
VARANASI: The holy city is under a heavy security blanket today as the Chief Justice of India (CJI), Justice Surya Kant, along with Allahabad High Court Chief Justice Arun Bhansali and a delegation of 5 Supreme Court and 18 High Court judges, arrives for a two-day visit.

The Schedule:

Today (Jan 16): The judicial delegation will arrive in Varanasi and perform darshan-pujan at the Kashi Vishwanath Temple. They will stay overnight at the Taj Hotel.

Tomorrow (Jan 17): The team will proceed to Chandauli for a district-level program.

Traffic Advisory (Crucial for Commuters): Divisional Commissioner S. Rajalingam and ADCP Traffic Anshuman Mishra have issued strict guidelines to ensure security and smooth movement:

No Vehicle Zone: The Maidagin to Godowlia route is completely closed to vehicles.

Evening Diversions: From 6:00 PM, vehicles going from Godowlia to the temple will be diverted via Pandey Haveli and Ramapura.

Entry Restrictions:

Heavy Vehicles: Goods carriers from Padao/Sujabad are banned from entering the city after 3:00 PM (diverted to Ramnagar).

Cars: Four-wheelers from the same route are banned after 5:00 PM.

Tourist Buses: Banned at Nammo Ghat. Parking is designated at Basanta College and Pani Tanki Railway Ground.

Saturday Alert: On Jan 17, four-wheeler traffic from Chandauli to Varanasi via Ring Road Phase-2 will be suspended from 8:00 AM.
